# Files exempted from the presentation layer boundary check in
# .github/workflows/flutter_ci.yml (repository-policy job).
#
# The rule: nothing under lib/app/** or lib/features/*/presentation/** may call
# FirebaseAuth.instance, FirebaseFirestore.instance or FirebaseStorage.instance
# directly. Data access goes through a repository. See
# docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md, hard rule 1.
#
# This file exists so an exception is a reviewed line in a diff rather than an
# `// ignore` comment buried in a widget. Adding a path here means a reviewer
# agreed the boundary should not apply, and the reason belongs in the PR that
# adds it.
#
# One repository-relative path per line. Comments and blank lines are ignored
# by the check because it matches whole lines exactly.
#
# Empty on purpose: the tree has no exceptions today.
